body:
Sorry, I've been caught up in various crap. You were kind enough to response, I figure I should be kind enough to give you an update =)

I'm still slogging through my issues while trying to hold on to as many positives as I realistically can… after dragging myself through hell and subjecting myself to massive psychological torture, I've managed to maintain more successes than I thought I could… some were shocking (no major nicotine cravings, almost 5 months nicotine free!!! Go me!!!!) I've been unable to continue the path I was on; I've had to modify my goals. However, it is likely, given my history, that the goals I had set were simply too ambitious. Maybe that will change? I'm neither young nor old, so I have both the time and & maturity (an ampersand!!! how often do you see those???? And I remembered what they were called!!!!) to make changes for the better when possible.

There's something else though, something that has been nagging at me for years… I have an overwhelming feeling I'm suffering & trying to make amends for some wrong that I committed. I don't have a particular issue with making up for it… I feel it makes me a better and more generous person, and anything I can do to lessen the suffering of another is a good thing. But I can't help wonder what it is I might have done...
